# apipbx_api_key (Resource)

An API key. The secret is only available in the state of the apply that created it; an imported key has no secret.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Scope the key to one tenant; omit for a platform key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive)
